From frame 1 to frame 16 it slides slowly to the right by roughly 50 px per panel width, without changing shape; from about frame 6 onward its right end is cut off by the right frame edge, and by frames 13-16 the lower-right tick is only a stub at the edge. A grey scenery cloud at the left edge drifts right with it and gets slightly larger and more lobed. The black outline itself never deforms: it is the same rigid drawing translated.
seen_film: A static shot of a wide white cumulus bank against blue sky, filling the lower half to two-thirds of the frame and running off both side edges and the bottom. Over the 16 frames the cloud billows in place: the left mound rises and swells (frames 5-12 it is a tall rounded bump at upper left), the dip between the left and right masses shifts and deepens, the right mass stays high and pushes to the right edge, and in frames 13-16 small wisps appear along the top edge at the left and center. There is little lateral drift; the change is a slow churning of the top silhouette.
